<thought>Based on the mass spectrum (M+H = 141.115 Da) the neutral mass is ~140.108 Da, which fits the formula C₈H₁₂O₂ (exact mass 140.084 Da). The ¹³C NMR shows eight carbon signals: a carbonyl at 167 ppm (typical for a carboxylic acid/ester), two sp² carbons at 143.9 and 130.3 ppm (an internal C=C), and several aliphatic carbons (34.5, 34.5, 22.8, 21.4, 19.2 ppm). This pattern is consistent with a cyclohexene ring bearing a carboxylic acid group and a methyl substituent, giving three degrees of unsaturation (one ring, one C=C, one carbonyl). The SMILES that matches this description is **O=C(O)C1=CCCCC1C**.</thought>
<final_answer>O=C(O)C1=CCCCC1C</final_answer>
